_comment: #453 G2 CANONICAL (user ruling 2026-08-13): the classless answer to the gate-road ambush. The sibling of blink_bypass_loop -- same road, same encounter, same bypass vocabulary -- except this build holds NOTHING. It walks up to the drainage cut at (27,24), goes down into it, then crosses goblin_encounter_1's radius-2 band (x 28-32, y 21-25) at y=22 and comes out the far side with no fight and one banked `crossed_under_cover`, the counter [Rogue]'s `accomplishment_any` entry now reads. WHY IT MATTERS: before this arm a level-1 classless PC had ZERO shipped way past this encounter -- the geometry is sealed (every route to the Liscor gate crosses the band) and every other bypass on the proximity pass is skill-gated, which is exactly why `sneaked_past_danger` could not gate [Rogue]'s own entry without circularity. Route authored to prove the arm and nothing else: the cut sits OUTSIDE the band so it is reachable un-sprung; y=22 is chosen over y=23 because the ambush entity blocks its own cell at (30,23); and the run walks well past the far edge so the dedupe is asserted over FOUR in-band steps, not one. ABSENCE IS PROVED ON THE EVENT STREAM, not on state: `assert_state` fails a missing path, so 'this counter has not banked yet' is pinned as an absent `accomplishment_recorded` with the id in `payload_contains`. The class-gain half of G2 is pinned in tests/test_progression.gd (`accomplishment_any`, all three arms) rather than re-proved here -- the blink_bypass_loop precedent: a road canonical proves the counters bank, the unit suite proves what they unlock. No combat resolves, so the fixture's cloned rng_state is inert.

steps._comment: Standing at (26,24), already facing right onto the cut at (27,24) -- Chebyshev 4 from the ambush, two cells clear of its band, so nothing has been risked yet.

GOING TO GROUND. One interact on the cut banks took_the_low_road and, through `once_per_waking`, the serve: ledger key the ambush's cover_prop arm reads. This alone is worth NO class credit -- the next step pins that crossed_under_cover has not banked.
steps.name: interact

steps._comment: THE CROSSING. Up two to (26,22) -- still outside the band -- then east. The prop blocks its own cell, so the cut is not itself the road. The FIRST in-band step is (28,22), Chebyshev 2: that is where the proximity pass runs and where the counter banks.
DEDUPE. Three more in-band steps, straight across the ambush's own latitude at Chebyshev 1. The count stays at 1 (once per encounter per waking) and the fight stays absent for every one of them.

OUT THE FAR SIDE, on the gate's own approach lane at (31,24) -- the cell the steel thread walks to before stepping into liscor_gate. The ambush is still standing: nothing removed, nothing made dormant, no skill used. It simply did not spring today.
